summary: Frontend-only bug re-test after profile button fix. Result: FIX CONFIRMED. Profile button (testID=open-profile) is now 44x44, positioned in hero top-right (x=334, y=12), and hit-testing via document.elementFromPoint returns an element whose closest ancestor IS the button itself — meaning the previously-intercepting LinearGradient overlay no longer blocks the tap. Clicking it navigates to /profile reliably (verified twice, including after returning to home). All 4 new profile shortcuts (open-achievements, open-goals, open-stats, open-history) are visible on the profile screen, tappable, and route to /achievements, /goals, /stats, /history respectively. Two non-blocking console warnings observed (see react_native_issues).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. The fix uses pointerEvents as a prop; on react-native-web this is deprecated. Migrate to style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }} (or add pointerEvents: 'none' to StyleSheet.absoluteFill / spacer style). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:118 and :123.

Console warning: '[Layout children]: No route named "import" exists in nested children'. The root _layout.tsx declares a Stack.Screen for a route named 'import' that no longer exists in /app. Remove the stale <Stack.Screen name="import" .../> entry. Reference: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx.

action_items: Optional cleanup: replace pointerEvents="none" prop with style-based pointerEvents on the LinearGradient overlay and spacer View in app/(tabs)/index.tsx to silence the react-native-web deprecation warning.
Optional cleanup: remove the stale <Stack.Screen name="import" /> declaration from app/_layout.tsx.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correctly applied at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx: heroTopBar has zIndex/elevation:10, profileBtn is 44x44 with hitSlop=16, gradient + spacer are pointerEvents='none'. This is the right pattern for tap-target rescue on RN Web.
profile.tsx correctly exposes testIDs open-achievements/goals/stats/history and each Pressable routes with router.push to the expected screen.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Profile button regression fully validated. Hit-test confirms overlay no longer intercepts. All 4 profile shortcut testIDs verified. Two deprecation warnings remain but are cosmetic (see react_native_issues).
rca_of_issue: Root cause of the original bug: the LinearGradient using StyleSheet.absoluteFill on top of the ImageBackground was capturing pointer events on web, and the flex:1 spacer View also stole taps. Mitigation applied by main agent: pointerEvents='none' on both, zIndex:10/elevation:10 on heroTopBar, bumped touch target to 44x44 with hitSlop:16. Verified via document.elementFromPoint that the top element at the button center resolves back to the button ancestor, and click navigates to /profile.
